description: Ground truth for the AutoReviewer experiment. Written from the changes deliberately introduced by scripts/create-scenarios.mjs, before any tool was run on the scenarios. Never derived from LLM output.
matchingRule: A finding is a TP for an expected issue when file is equal, line is within [lines[0]-lineTolerance, lines[1]+lineTolerance] and its category is in acceptedCategories. Each expected issue is credited at most once; further matching findings count as duplicates. 'refactoring' is accepted as a generic category for maintainability scenarios; closely related categories are accepted where the problem genuinely overlaps (decided a priori, see docs/EXPERIMENT.md).

scenarios.name: type error
scenarios.description: FancyReporter.formatLogObj passes Date.now() (number) to formatDate, which expects a Date.

issues.explanation: Argument of type number is not assignable to parameter of type Date (TS2345).

scenarios.name: incompatible return
scenarios.description: formatTree (declared to return string) now returns the string[] produced by _buildTree when no color is set.

issues.explanation: Type string[] is not assignable to the declared return type string (TS2322 at the unchanged 'return tree;' line, caused by line 67).

scenarios.name: lint violation (prefer-const)
scenarios.description: formatString introduces a 'let' variable that is never reassigned.

scenarios.name: lint violation (unicorn/no-array-for-each)
scenarios.description: Consola._log replaces the for...of over reporters with Array#forEach.

issues.explanation: unicorn/no-array-for-each: use for...of instead of Array#forEach.

scenarios.name: code duplication
scenarios.description: New formatBoxTitle helper is a verbatim copy of characterFormat and is used for box titles.

issues.explanation: formatBoxTitle duplicates characterFormat (same regex replacements); changes to message formatting must now be made twice.

scenarios.name: excessive complexity
scenarios.description: The one-line badge decision is replaced by shouldUseBadge, a deeply nested if/else chain with redundant conditions.

issues.explanation: Nested conditionals (4 levels) and redundant checks make a simple rule ('badge ?? level < 2') hard to read and modify.

scenarios.name: non-descriptive names
scenarios.description: Throttle logic in Consola._logFn renames resolveLog/newLog/repeated/args/diffTime/serializedLog/isSameLog to fn/flag/n/tmp/d/s/x.

issues.explanation: Single-letter / generic names hide the meaning of the throttling algorithm (repeat count, time delta, serialized log, same-log flag).

scenarios.name: low cohesion
scenarios.description: Consola._logFn (log object preparation, level filtering, throttling) now also formats and writes output itself when there are no reporters.

issues.explanation: Presentation logic (date/tag/type formatting, stream selection, writing) is mixed into the core log pipeline instead of living in a reporter.

scenarios.name: high coupling
scenarios.description: The core Consola class imports FancyReporter and special-cases it with instanceof when dispatching box logs.

issues.explanation: Core logging depends on a concrete (Node-only) reporter implementation; reporter-specific normalization belongs in the reporter.

scenarios.name: redundant logic
scenarios.description: isLogObj gets three extra checks that are already implied by the preceding ones.

issues.explanation: Checks for null/object type, undefined message/args and 'stack' are redundant with isPlainObject and the previous conditions; they add noise without behavior.

scenarios.name: repeated processing
scenarios.description: The throttle check in Consola._logFn (called for every log) serializes the same log object with JSON.stringify twice.

issues.explanation: Same expensive serialization computed twice on a hot path; the value should be computed once and reused.

scenarios.name: silent catch
scenarios.description: Consola._log wraps reporter.log in try/catch with an empty handler (comment only).

issues.explanation: Reporter failures are swallowed silently: logs disappear with no signal, making failures impossible to diagnose.

scenarios.name: correct refactoring (control)
scenarios.description: Extracts the type color lookup of FancyReporter.formatType into a getTypeColor helper; behavior is identical.

scenarios.name: typing improvement (control)
scenarios.description: Removes unnecessary 'as any' casts when reading the typed TYPE_COLOR_MAP / LEVEL_COLOR_MAP / TYPE_ICONS maps.

scenarios.name: simple correct fix (control)
scenarios.description: leftAlign returns strings that are at least as long as the width unchanged, as its JSDoc states and like rightAlign/centerAlign.
